performance.verdict: No paid activity launched; 5 SOW milestones overdue, engagement is bleeding.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch (LSA+Search), and Meta Retargeting all missed July 31–Aug 1 deadlines — zero paid activity for 28 days.
GHL shows 366 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — pipeline is not capturing or routing any leads despite contacts present.
Spend is $0 across all paid channels for the full 45-day series; CPL is undefined — the media budget of ~$6,500/mo is entirely undeployed.
IG reach last 3 days (Aug 22–24): 584, 772, 572 vs prior 3 days (Aug 19–21): 811, 762, 295 — essentially flat, but 3-day average of 643 is well below the Aug 10 peak of 4,307.
GBP actions flat at 0 for Aug 22–24 (last 3 days of series) vs a prior-3-day average of 5.7 actions — a short but notable drop in organic engagement.

suggestions.text: Unblock LSA verification submission immediately — it gates the entire Google Ads launch and requires 3–4 weeks to clear.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA verification was due July 31 and has not been submitted; every day it waits adds to the 3–4 week approval window. Submit the LSA application today via the Google Local Services Ads portal for Maadi Law's practice areas. Success check: confirmation email from Google received by Aug 26, 2026. No paid Google traffic can run until this clears — this is the single highest-leverage unblock available.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair GHL pipeline so 366 existing contacts produce at least 1 opportunity and 1 appointment before new paid traffic arrives.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 366 contacts with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — intake routing is broken or was never wired. Before paid ads launch, audit stage logic, routing rules, and form-to-pipeline connections in GHL. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created and 1 appointment booked by Aug 29, 2026, confirming the pipeline is functional before ad spend begins. Broken intake means any future leads will also disappear into this gap.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions over next 3 days; if daily actions remain at 0, escalate as an organic visibility issue before paid launch.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP averaged 5.7 actions/day Aug 19–21 but dropped to 0 for Aug 22–24. This may be a weekend effect or a listing issue. Monitor daily actions through Aug 28, 2026 — if the 3-day total remains at or near 0, flag for GBP listing audit (categories, hours, photos) before paid campaigns go live and depend on it for brand validation.
